documents.title: G10 — single-one word law
documents.raw_status: ** VERIFIED (numerical; first half exact on all 239 599 cases, combined law 0 counterexamples on its stated range)
header: **Status:** VERIFIED (numerical; first half exact on all 239 599 cases, combined law 0 counterexamples on its stated range)
> For one 1 at position `a` with `N ≥ 2a + 4`: `p(L) = min(L, a+1) + 1` for `L ≤ N − a − 1`, and `p(L) = N − L + 1` for `L ≥ N − a − 1`
- The word has a single 1 at position `a`; `N` is the truncation length, and the hypothesis is `N ≥ 2a + 4`.

documents.title: G11 — in the degenerate sliver N < 2a + 4 the halves do not simply patch together
header: > In the degenerate sliver `N < 2a + 4` the halves do **not** simply patch together
- Single-one word with the 1 at position `a`; the sliver is `N < 2a + 4`, the complement of register row G10's hypothesis.

documents.title: G3 — RS(L) runs for 1/π up to L = 699
header: > `RS(L)` for `L ≤ 699` runs `1` on `[1,10]`, `2` on `[11,13]`, `1` on `[14,604]`, `0` on `[605,699]` — i.e. `RS(L)` equals the slope wherever `Z(L) = 0`, exactly as C4 requires
- `RS(L)` is the right-special factor count of length `L`; `Z(L) = |F(L)| − #{prefixes of F(L+1)}` (register row C3).

documents.title: I5 — the number of usable residual-orbit steps is logarithmic in the working precision
header: > **The number of usable residual-orbit steps is logarithmic in the working precision.** For `x = 1/π`: dps 60→7 steps, 120→8, 200→9, 400→10, 800→11, 1600→12, 3200→13, i.e. `steps ≈ 2 + log₂(dps)`. Step `k` squares the residual, so it needs `~2^k` digits
- dps = decimal digits of working precision; the target is `x = 1/π`.
